name: robots/enac-drones__dronesim
title: dronesim CtrlAviary (PyBullet multi-drone simulation)
intro: dronesim CtrlAviary (PyBullet multi-drone simulation), adapted from enac-drones/dronesim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
